open_points.subject: _record_viewer_entry_attempt
open_points.text: MUST drop attempts older than the window from the bucket for the supplied key, return false without recording when the remaining count is at or above the allowed attempts, and otherwise record the attempt and return true.
open_points.other_text: It MUST keep total memory bounded by pruning buckets that hold no attempt inside the window, and MUST NOT distinguish its refusal by account state, by whether a capability exists, or by any other fact about the presented credential.
open_points.question: Which requirement must change: preserving every in-window attempt for arbitrarily many distinct keys, or keeping total memory bounded? Pruning only buckets without an in-window attempt cannot bound memory when arbitrarily many keys have live attempts.

open_points.subject: install_transport_guards
open_points.text: answer an OPTIONS request carrying an Origin listed in settings.allowed_origins with a 204 preflight echoing only the requested method and headers plus Vary Origin, and reject an unlisted origin with 403;
open_points.other_text: Every response it produces or forwards, including each rejection above, MUST pass through _apply_security_headers with the request id and the _requires_no_store decision for the canonical path, and MUST carry the CORS allow-origin, allow-credentials and Vary headers only when the request Origin is listed in settings.allowed_origins.
open_points.question: Must an allowed preflight carry the CORS allow-origin and allow-credentials headers required of every response with a listed Origin, or only the requested method and headers plus Vary Origin?
